name: Wyoming Fudge Company LLC
old_description: Founded by Kristy Sims, Wyoming Fudge Company is a proud, female-owned small business built on a lifelong passion for premium sweets. Made fresh in Gillette, every batch blends real butter, fresh cream, and time-honored recipes to bring a sweet taste of the West straight to your table.
about:
Wyoming Fudge Company LLC operates from Gillette, Wyoming, where it celebrated a soft opening on January 12, 2025. The business is woman-owned, founded by Kristy Sims, who first pursued a fudge shop in Pinedale years earlier before closing it to focus on a long-running office supply venture. After selling that store in 2025, she returned to confectionery, purchasing a building in Gillette to be near family and rebuilding the operation from the ground up.

The company produces handcrafted fudge in small batches using real butter, fresh cream, and traditional recipes. Its product line spans cheesecake-inspired assortments, candy-infused flavors, chocolate swirls, and seasonal offerings such as pumpkin latte and pumpkin pecan. Production details such as facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

Wyoming Fudge Company serves three primary channels: wholesale partnerships with boutiques, gift shops, and specialty markets across Wyoming; corporate gifting programs that provide custom-branded boxes and dessert displays for businesses and private events; and fundraising programs for schools, sports teams, and non-profit organizations. Retail partners are mapped on the company's website.

Sims frames the venture as a lifelong passion for premium sweets and a way to bring a taste of the West to customers. The business also highlights its family's connection to spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 (SCA2), using its platform to raise awareness and support research through the National Ataxia Foundation.
